ukm:Metadata.dc:title: The Universal Credit, Personal Independence Payment, Jobseeker’s Allowance and Employment and Support Allowance (Claims and Payments) (Amendment No. 2) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2026
ukm:Metadata.dc:subject: SOCIAL SECURITY
ukm:Metadata.dc:description: These Regulations amend the Universal Credit, Personal Independence Payment, Jobseeker’s Allowance and Employment and Support Allowance (Claims and Payments) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2016 (S.R. 2016 No. 220) so as to make provision for reclaims of universal credit for claimants taking part in a funded employment scheme.

SecondaryPrelims.Title: The Universal Credit, Personal Independence Payment, Jobseeker’s Allowance and Employment and Support Allowance (Claims and Payments) (Amendment No. 2) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2026

P.Text: The Department for Communities makes these Regulations in exercise of the powers conferred by Sections 1(1) and 165(1), (4) and (6) of the Social Security Administration (Northern Ireland) Act 1992 and now vested in it.

Para.Text: The powers are exercisable by the Department for Communities by virtue of Article 2 of the Welfare Reform (Northern Ireland) Order 2015 (Cessation of Transitory Provision) Order 2020.

P1para.Text: These Regulations may be cited as the Universal Credit, Personal Independence Payment, Jobseeker’s Allowance and Employment and Support Allowance (Claims and Payments) (Amendment No. 2) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2026 and come into operation on 30 November 2026.
